notice: Preview version · Illustrative items and prices · Every order is confirmed by the bookshop.

hero.title: A page opens. We deliver it to you.
hero.intro: Books, school supplies and office stationery. Fill your basket in a few clicks for home delivery in Yaoundé, with payment on delivery.

strip.step1: 01 / Choose your items — A simple catalogue for school and office.
strip.step2: 02 / Give your address — Neighbourhood, landmark and preferred time slot.
strip.step3: 03 / Pay on delivery — Cash, Orange Money or MTN MoMo, once activated.

catalogue.title: It all starts here.
catalogue.searchPlaceholder: Search for a notebook, a pen…

lists.title: A school list? We'll handle the rest.
lists.text: Gather the books and supplies requested by the school. Prepare your quote request with the class, references and quantities.
lists.editionTitle: The right item, the right edition.
lists.editionText: Each book must be confirmed by its title, author and edition. Any substitution requires your approval.
lists.businessText: Paper, binders, pens and supplies: list your recurring needs in your quote request.
lists.whatsapp: Send your list directly via WhatsApp from the quote form.

delivery.title: Delivery, made clear.
delivery.step1Text: Give your neighbourhood and a precise landmark. Delivery areas will be confirmed by the bookshop.
delivery.step2Text: Fees depend on your neighbourhood (table below). Availability and lead time are confirmed before dispatch.
delivery.step3Text: Check your parcel, then pay on delivery. No online payment is requested in this version.

terms.title: About this version
terms.p1: This site is a private preview of the upcoming service of the Librairie Papeterie du Centre. Products, prices and visuals are illustrative.
terms.p2: Your basket is stored only in your browser. The form information is used to create your summary.
terms.p3: Before commercial launch: complete the legal notice, add real prices and stock, validate the delivery table.
